proposals.before: In the twelfth year Dezong campaigned against the Xi and took seven thousand households.
proposals.after: In the twelfth year Dezu campaigned against the Xi and took seven thousand households.
proposals.reason: Chinese 德祖 is the temple name Dezu (Taizu's father), not Dezong.

proposals.before: In the twelfth year Dezong attacked the Xi and captured seven thousand households.
proposals.after: In the twelfth year Dezu attacked the Xi and captured seven thousand households.
proposals.reason: Chinese 德祖 is Dezu, not Dezong.

proposals.before: In the fifth year of his reign the Taizu attacked western and eastern Xi, subdued them entirely, and held all the Xi and Mohe peoples.
proposals.after: In the fifth year of his reign the Taizu attacked western and eastern Xi, subdued them entirely, and held all the Xi and Ru peoples.
proposals.reason: Chinese 霫 denotes the Ru people paired with the Xi, not the Mohe (靺鞨).

proposals.before: In the fifth year of the Taizu's reign he attacked the western and eastern Xi, pacified them all, and wholly possessed the Xi and Mohe peoples.
proposals.after: In the fifth year of the Taizu's reign he attacked the western and eastern Xi, pacified them all, and wholly possessed the Xi and Ru peoples.
proposals.reason: Chinese 霫 denotes the Ru people, not Mohe.

decisions.reason: Chinese 德祖 is the temple name Dezu; Dezong (德宗) is a different title, so the idiomatic misnames the campaigner.
Chinese 德祖 is Dezu, not Dezong; the literal repeats the same wrong temple name.

decisions.after: In the fifth year of his reign the Taizu attacked western and eastern Xi, subdued them entirely, and held all the Xi and Xí peoples.
decisions.reason: 霫 denotes the Xí people, distinct from both the Xi (奚) and the Mohe (靺鞨); the worker's reading Ru was incorrect.

decisions.after: In the fifth year of the Taizu's reign he attacked the western and eastern Xi, pacified them all, and wholly possessed the Xi and Xí peoples.
decisions.reason: 霫 denotes the Xí people, distinct from both the Xi (奚) and the Mohe (靺鞨); the worker's reading Ru was incorrect.
